steps.say: A prime number has exactly two factors, 1 and itself. 7 is prime because only 1 × 7 makes 7.
A number with more than two factors is called composite. 9 is composite because 3 × 3 = 9.
1 is not prime, because it has only one factor. 2 is the only even prime number.
A square number is a whole number times itself. It makes a square array.

figure.alt: An array of 4 rows of 4 dots making a square.

steps.say: The first ten square numbers go up to 10 × 10 = 100.

figure.alt: A row of boxes with the square numbers from 1 to 100.

steps.say: We write 5 squared as 5². It means 5 × 5.

hints: A prime number has exactly two factors.
Try dividing each number by 2, 3 and 5.
Start with 21: can you divide it by 3?
check.explanation: 29 can only be divided exactly by 1 and 29, so it is prime.

options.why: 27 = 3 × 9, so it has more than two factors.
25 = 5 × 5, so it is a square number with three factors.

hints: Squared means a number multiplied by itself.

check.prompt: Which number is both a square number and an even number?
hints: List the square numbers up to 100.
Check each option against both rules.
check.explanation: 36 = 6 × 6, so it is a square number, and it ends in 6, so it is even.

options.why: 49 is a square number, but it is odd.
18 is even, but no whole number times itself makes 18.
25 is a square number, but it is odd.
